name: Harvey
desc: Generative AI platform purpose-built for law firm and in-house legal work.
desc_zh: 面向律所与企业法务的生成式 AI 工作平台。
solves: Legal research eats hours and every claim needs a citation. It drafts work and points back to the source document.
solves_zh: 法律检索要耗掉几小时，而且每条结论都得给出处。它能起草文书，并指回原始文件。
best_for: When a lawyer or legal team needs a first draft or document review with traceable sources.
best_for_zh: 律师或法务团队需要初稿、或需要带可追溯出处的文件审阅的时候。
notes: The clearest case of a vertical AI product winning an entire regulated profession. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harvey_(software)
